Name: Stardrips Coffee
Author: ryck215
Description:
[b][b]~~1.6 Compatibility will [i]not[/i] be present at launch.  I hope to update it a month or two after launch~~[/b]

[/b]1.5 Compatible

This mod adds 9 new coffee/espresso drinks and associated cooking recipes to Stardew Valley for Stardrips Coffee, each of which give a buff to your speed, as well as another skill based on which one you drink.


[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Ensure JsonAssets and SpaceCore are installed
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Requirements[/size]
[list]
[*]JsonAssets https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720
[*]SpaceCore https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
By default, you start with one recipe to make a Stardrips Cafe Misto. The remaining 8 recipes are sold by various NPCs around the game.

NPCs Selling Recipes:
[spoiler][list]
[*]Pierre
[*]Sandy
[*]Harvey
[*]Marlon
[*]Willy
[*]Dwarf
[*]Krobus
[*]Robin
[/list][/spoiler]

Each drink provides a set of buffs for a limited time after consuming.

Drink Effects:
[spoiler][list]
[*]Stardrips Cafe Misto - Speed Only
[*]Stardrips Cappuccino - Speed and Max Energy
[*]Stardrips Caramel Machiato - Speed and Defense
[*]Stardrips Chocolate Mocha - Speed and Mining
[*]Stardrips Coconut Milk Latte - Speed and Farming
[*]Stardrips Hazelnut Latte - Speed and Attack
[*]Stardrips Maple Latte - Speed and Fishing
[*]Stardrips Pumpkin Spice Latte - Speed and Foraging
[*]Stardrips Sweet Gem Mocha - Speed and Luck
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.4 and 1.5
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer.
[*]Works with Khadija's Recipe Shop - ﻿https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5245
[*]No known mod conflicts
[/list]Any questions or issues, please don't hesitate to reach out.
